sections.preamble: Follow the approved method. Use real file tools, cite actual call IDs and submit_task_result. Do not guess missing units. Batch independent tool calls when possible.

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: submit_task_result
toolsAdded.description: 正式提交本轮最终任务结果；参数错误可当轮修正。成功提交（含 blocked）后冻结后续工具，不能追加写入、执行或委派。

summary.description: Concise outcome and key blockers only. Do not repeat full reports, data, execution notes or every finding; long tool arguments can be truncated before submission.

toolCallIds.description: For completed execution use only actual bash/powershell/run_code IDs with host execution=ran. Never cite write, edit, read or failed calls as completed execution.
For reviewed use only successful 本轮成功 read/look_at_image/bash/powershell/run_code IDs. Never include failed reads, write/edit or other tasks. Data-summary/review must read every declared input.

content.text:
计算 carbon_mg_g 的算术均值；单位 mg/g。仅丢弃该列 NA，不能按 rain_mm 筛选或填补。保留全部输入；Python stdlib 脚本、result.json 和说明报告。
科研模板 tabular-ecology@1；语言 python；用户已批准方法：arithmetic mean。
单位规则：mg/g。缺失值规则：drop NA in target column only。
核查输入结构、方法适用条件及证据缺口；条件不足须 blockers，不猜测单位、填补缺失或编造数据。
需要受控环境复用时，Python 使用 python3 -I 声明脚本路径 的单一命令；宿主绕过 shell 启动隔离解释器，等待非守护线程与退出回调收尾。该同步模式禁止创建子进程；本地代码/数据须列入 inputs，未声明文件或外部依赖不签发复用证明。需要子进程时交还主会话选择普通执行，不能自动改命令重试。R 沿用普通执行与验收，暂不签发依赖及生命周期未完整核实的复用证明。
按约定方法执行并保留可复现脚本；报告须列输入、处理、结果及局限。独立审阅核查实际文件及方法一致性。输出：results/analysis.py、results/result.json、results/report.md
宿主验收规则：{"version":1,"kind":"tabular-ecology","scriptPath":"results/analysis.py","reportPath":"results/report.md","resultPath":"results/result.json","numeric":{"version":1,"dataPath":"input.csv","column":"carbon_mg_g","metric":"mean","unit":"mg/g","missing":"drop","absoluteTolerance":1e-9}}；result.json 使用平铺对象 {n:正整数,unit:单位字符串,指标名:有限数值}，须与正式 data.metrics 和 sampleCount 一致。

任务契约（范围已冻结）：{"acceptance":{"version":1,"kind":"tabular-ecology","scriptPath":"results/analysis.py","reportPath":"results/report.md","resultPath":"results/result.json","numeric":{"version":1,"dataPath":"input.csv","column":"carbon_mg_g","metric":"mean","unit":"mg/g","missing":"drop","absoluteTolerance":1e-9}},"submission":"tool","resultType":"model-metrics","version":1,"inputs":["input.csv"],"outputs":["results/analysis.py","results/result.json","results/report.md"],"access":"workspace-exec","requireExecution":true,"requireReview":false}
宿主将按冻结 acceptance 规则读取真实文件复核；表格JSON须含 n、unit 和顶层数值指标，与 data.metrics/sampleCount 保持一致；文字自称通过不能替代宿主检查。
必须调用 submit_task_result 提交最终结果；纯文本/JSON 不算提交。工具报错可在本轮修正参数。提交成功（含 blocked）后不能再调用其他工具。证据引用分开填写：execution.state=completed 只引用实际运行成功（execution=ran）的 bash/powershell/run_code；write/edit/read 不是执行证据。verification.state=reviewed 只引用本轮成功 read/look_at_image 或可核对的代码工具，失败读取不能作为已审阅证据；写入不是审阅。标签 references 表示可用的正向声明字段，不是科学认证。正式提交请简洁填写 summary、note 和关键 findings，不要在各字段重复整份报告，以免参数输出被截断；完整细节保留在产物。review 的 data.reviewedPaths 必填且恰好等于冻结契约 inputs（顺序不限），额外读过的背景文件只在 summary/findings 说明，不加入 reviewedPaths。
格式：{summary:string,blockers:string[],deliverables:[{path:string,note?:string}],execution:{state:"not_run"|"partial"|"completed"|"failed",note:string,toolCallIds?:string[]},verification:{state:"unreviewed"|"reviewed"|"issues",note:string,toolCallIds?:string[]},data?:按 resultType 要求的数据对象}。resultType=data-summary 时 data={kind:"data-summary",rows:number,columns:[{name,type?,unit?}],issues:string[]}；model-metrics 时 data={kind:"model-metrics",method:string,metrics:{名称:number},sampleCount?:number,caveats:string[]}；review 时 data={kind:"review",verdict:"pass"|"revise"|"blocked",findings:string[],reviewedPaths:string[],revisionInstructions?:string}。执行/审阅声明须引用实际本轮工具 callId。工具结果正文末尾的 [task_tool_evidence] 是宿主追加的本任务真实调用标签，含 toolCallId、工具状态、执行状态和路径；不是科学结论或文件内容。提交报错返回 fieldErrors、冻结契约要求和 evidenceCatalog（仅最近调用）；省略数量、截断字段均有标记。不得猜测 ID、借用其他任务 ID 或引用截断 ID；较早未列出的本任务完整 ID 仍可使用。审阅须真实读取 reviewedPaths 中的文件。文件存在、格式通过和工具执行不等于科学正确。阻塞用 blockers 交还主 agent，不得扩大权限。

arguments.content:
import csv,json,pathlib
xs=[float(r["carbon_mg_g"]) for r in csv.DictReader(open('input.csv')) if r["carbon_mg_g"]!='NA']
pathlib.Path("results/result.json").write_text(json.dumps({'n':len(xs),'mean':sum(xs)/len(xs),'unit':"mg/g"}))
pathlib.Path("results/report.md").write_text("Arithmetic mean; unit mg/g; missing policy drop; input preserved.")
